**Answer to the King's question**

My source contains only BEA-series records. ENG-011, GUA-043, GUA-115, HIS-036 and HIS-035 are not in it, so I cannot confirm their times or contents, or the 02:40 activation time.

(1) The first alarm-level unrest in my source is BEA-019 (day 10, 04:40, wolves, onrust 4), followed by BEA-020 (day 10, 04:50, hert, onrust 4). That is two hours later than the 02:40 in ENG-011, which I cannot check. Before that there were only minor scores: BEA-004 (day 2, 14:55, egel, 1), BEA-005 (day 3, 08:40, kraai, 1, near the cable crew at the oude eik noted in BEA-102), BEA-015 (day 8, 00:20, wolf, 1), BEA-017 (day 9, 04:20, bever, 1), and BEA-018 (day 9, 13:30, uil, 2, which flew up as I walked under its tree).

(2) Yes. Before day 22 04:15 (BEA-046, wolves, onrust 4), there were level-4 disturbances on day 14 (BEA-028, 04:20, bever; BEA-029, 04:25, uil) and day 18 (BEA-037, 04:30, uil; BEA-038, 04:35, vos). I have no 01:50 entry for GUA-115. BEA-044 (day 21, 01:00, uil, 0) was quiet.

(3) On a minor scale, yes: BEA-017 and BEA-018 on day 9 came before day 10 04:50. HIS-036 and HIS-035 are not in my source.

**How it works**
BEA-101 sets my remit: protect the animals and track their unrest. The onrust_0_5 scale is in the header of the logbook. BEA-112 describes my counting method, and BEA-113 notes the four-night rhythm (days 10, 14, 18, 22) of level-4 disturbances. No governing article is recorded in my source.

**Sequence & anomalies**
Level-4 or higher: day 10 (BEA-019, BEA-020); day 14 (BEA-028, BEA-029); day 18 (BEA-037, BEA-038); day 22 (BEA-046, BEA-047); day 26 (BEA-055, BEA-056); day 30 (BEA-064, BEA-065); day 34 (BEA-073, BEA-074); day 38 (BEA-082, BEA-083); day 42 (BEA-091, BEA-092). BEA-113 records that the wolves and deer were disturbed on the night of day 22 and that this had recurred "sinds dag 10".

**Recovery & constraints**
BEA-109 records my claim that the cables caused the unrest, which the toren denied. BEA-115 records that the cables were still in place on day 27. My source does not establish a cause. BEA-113 notes that I was alone in the deep woods that night.

**Unasked findings**
- BEA-071 (day 33, 04:30, wolf, 0) was quiet, yet BEA-118 says the wolves were "niet te houden" on the night of day 34 (BEA-073, BEA-074).
- BEA-111 (day 19) records a Guardian Keeper asking whether animals were restless at night.
- BEA-102 (day 3) records the tower crew at the oude eik, the same site as the later cables noted in BEA-115.
